content: Cefuroxime axetil tablets (Ceftin) and cefuroxime axetil oral suspension (Ceftin for Oral Suspension) are not bioequivalent. They cannot be substituted for one another on a milligram-per-milligram basis. This distinction is important and is further detailed in the Clinical Pharmacology section. The safety and efficacy of Ceftin tablets for the treatment of acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis have not been established when administered for less than 10 days. Ceftin for Oral Suspension can be administered to pediatric patients aged 3 months to 12 years, following the dosage guidelines provided in the prescribing information. The safety and efficacy of cefuroxime axetil in patients with renal failure have not been established. Since cefuroxime is eliminated through the kidneys, its half-life is prolonged in patients with renal failure, necessitating careful consideration in such cases. To prepare the oral suspension, first shake the bottle to loosen the powder. Remove the cap, add the total amount of water required for reconstitution (as specified in the instructions), and replace the cap. Invert the bottle and rock it vigorously from side to side to allow the water to mix with the powder. Once the sound of the powder against the bottle is no longer audible, turn the bottle upright and shake it vigorously in a diagonal direction to ensure thorough mixing. Before each use, shake the oral suspension well. After opening, securely replace the cap. Store the reconstituted suspension in a refrigerator at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). Discard any unused suspension after 10 days.
